title: Pilot trust stage caps the class
goal: A job's class is capped by its pilot's stage (a Prototype pilot never runs in EVA-02)
acceptance: Admission reads the pilot and stage from F-045 and F-025; the cap only lowers, never raises, a class
Tests for each stage and class
privacy: Neutral repository-owned fixtures only; no credentials, model calls or external effects in tests.
validation: Unit and join tests; npm test
escalation: Waits on F-045-T01 (pilot registry) and F-025-T04 (trust stages)

effort.basis: Planned 2026-11-11 from the F-049 Check and the execution-boundaries assessment, after the owner asked why only F-049-T01 was planned. Later steps depend on T01/T03 findings; the owner may revise any split. Estimate, not a measurement. Numbers backfilled 2026-11-11 at harness 5.4.0 from this estimate (rounded up to a quarter day); the baseline is this estimate, not an original one. Re-estimated 2026-11-11 in agent hours (harness 5.6.0): 1.5 hours agent; former 1-day estimate at 1.5 agent hours per focused day. Method: a judged rate of about 1.5 agent hours per former focused day, not a calculation, informed by NERV merge history (50 feature and fix PRs #140–#276, previous merge to merge, a throughput proxy: median about 0.56 h, p75 2.1–2.7 h by quantile method, p90 about 5.1 h) and B-046-T02 (2-day estimate, about 0.75 h stated to implement); a step that is a PR of its own takes at least 0.75 h with review and CI, while an agent part that only prepares or records for an owner step may be less. Machine time of real-model or device runs is not counted. Estimate, not a measurement; baselineDays 1 kept as history.
